Administrator read-only stack diagnostic entry is prepared/frozen at SHA6621497d6e4e815a2076ce565d9d820e7f5e8236c21b5149b17f0157c286e4b0. It is fixed to native Vivado3583093/start66052106 and does not attach/resume the retired guard or monitors. Engineering only ran plan/preflight and two isolated Python-process tests, not a production attachment. The original frozen guard loop and current external monitor have separate recorded byte identities.

Administrator actually performed one fixed read-only capture at2026-10-26T10:14:40UTC: DG_20261026T101440Z_108d446e, frozen script SHA unchanged, no further production attachment by engineering. 本AT只读盘点时340文件，61个内部.rtd共1,217,755,216B、48个.rtd.completed及.pb/Tcl/log等均原样保留，不冒称可恢复DCP。本机官方write/open/read_checkpoint依赖当前响应的设计或已保存DCP；open_run/launch_runs-next_step属于已有项目run。当前直接synth_design尚未返回、无已有checkpoint；所查本机Tcl手册未找到.rtd读取接口，不能外推绝无厂商恢复方法。未启动任何EDA、缓存恢复试验、生产调用/内存改写/信号。

源码f849/91源与ROM、父/11generic、完整子树、原300MHz及PS暂停保持；物理无墙钟/256GiB/系统余量/单锁保护保持。原D37功能范围不变；最终完整资源/fit/P&R/setup/hold/覆盖仍未验。等待主控基于实际符号给出连续恢复边界。
